channel.title: Government Emergency Monitoring
channel.description: Normalized Government of Canada emergency-related feeds

item.title: Minister Anandasangaree to highlight federal budget investments in Vaughan
item.description: Members of the media are invited to join the Honourable Gary Anandasangaree, Minister of Public Safety, for an event to highlight federal budget investments to build a stronger, more independent and resilient economy, and make life more affordable for Canadians.

item.title: Ministers Olszewski and Gauvin to hold a press conference following the Federal-Provincial-Territorial (FPT) Meeting on Emergency Management in Edmonton
item.description: Members of the media are invited to join the Honourable Eleanor Olszewski, Minister of Emergency Management and Community Resilience and Minister responsible for Prairies Economic Development Canada, and her co-chair and New Brunswick counterpart, the Honourable Robert Gauvin, Minister of Public Safety and Minister responsible for La Francophonie, for a press conference following the Federal-Provincial-Territorial (FPT) meeting of Ministers Responsible for Emergency Management.

item.title: Ministers Olszewski and Gauvin to host the 2026 Emergency Management Exemplary Service Award Ceremony in Edmonton
item.description: Members of the media are invited to join the Honourable Eleanor Olszewski, Minister of Emergency Management and Community Resilience and Minister responsible for Prairies Economic Development Canada, along with her co-chair and New Brunswick counterpart, the Honourable Robert Gauvin, Minister of Public Safety and Minister responsible for La Francophonie, as they present awards recognizing excellence in emergency management across Canada.

item.title: Governments of Canada and Manitoba invest in strengthening the Manitoba First Nations Police Service and First Nations Safety Officer Program
item.description: The Manitoba First Nations Police Service (MFNPS) will receive close to $121 million over four years to help build long-term capacity and advance First Nations led, culturally informed policing in the communities they serve. This funding supports a series of priority initiatives, including the establishment of a dedicated training academy, and the expansion of MFNPS services to the Fisher River Cree Nation and the Gambler First Nation.

item.title: Government of Canada provides an update the 2026 wildfire season – October update
item.description: Wildfire seasons are now longer, more complex and more challenging than in the past, and 2026 was no exception. After a slower than average start to the season, wildfire activity, driven by periods of prolonged heat, drought and low humidity, became significant in several regions across the country. Northwestern Ontario and Southern British Columbia were particularly affected, experiencing sustained wildfire activity that threatened communities and critical infrastructure. Wildfire activity was also extremely intense in the Northwest Territories, which accounted for over one third of the total area burned in Canada in 2026.

item.title: Governments of Canada and Manitoba to announce funding for Indigenous police services and community safety in Manitoba
item.description: Members of the media are invited to join the Honourable Gary Anandasangaree, Minister of Public Safety, along with the Honourable Matt Wiebe, Minister of Justice and Attorney General of Manitoba, for an announcement to strengthen community safety and policing in Indigenous communities in Manitoba.

item.title: Government of Canada invests in Youth Gang Prevention in Manitoba and Alberta
item.description: Today, the Honourable Gary Anandasangaree, Minister of Public Safety, announced $1.6 million in federal funding to the Joy Smith Foundation through the Youth Gang Prevention Fund (YGPF) to support a project that will help prevent violence, gang involvement and criminal activity among at-risk and incarcerated youth aged 12 to 30 in Manitoba and Alberta.

item.title: Government of Canada announces funding to enhance online safety for Indigenous youth
item.description: Protecting children and youth from online exploitation requires prevention, education and strong community partnerships.

item.title: Federal government invests in Canadian Red Cross to support Canadians during emergencies
item.description: Today, the Honourable Eleanor Olszewski, Minister of Emergency Management and Community Resilience and Minister responsible for Prairies Economic Development Canada, announced more than $15.6 million through the Humanitarian Workforce Program to strengthen the Canadian Red Cross's readiness to respond when disasters occur. In May 2026, the Government renewed the Humanitarian Workforce Program and committed $108 million to strengthen Canada’s disaster response capacity. Today’s investment is the first project announced as part of that renewal, and additional projects will follow.

item.title: Minister Olszewski to highlight emergency preparedness efforts in Edmonton
item.description: Members of the media are invited to join the Honourable Eleanor Olszewski, Minister of Emergency Management and Community Resilience and Minister responsible for Prairies Economic Development Canada, for an announcement with the Canadian Red Cross in Edmonton to strengthen support for communities across Canada during emergencies.
